Class BankPaymentFlowController

public without sharing class BankPaymentFlowController

Invocable Apex action used by Flow to send a payment via MercuryService. Routes by PaymentRequest (billPayment, commissionPayment, or manual), creates a BankTransaction__c, and updates the linked record's status (Bill__c -> transferred, CommissionPayment__c -> paid). Returns a one-element string array with a human-readable status.

@InvocableMethod(category='BlazeBite' description='Send payments using the Mercury API' label='Send Payment')
public static List<String> send(List<PaymentRequest> payments)

Sends one payment via MercuryService. Reads only payments[0] — Flow batches @InvocableMethod calls but this implementation processes one request at a time. Determines the payment class from the PaymentRequest (presence of billId, commissionPaymentId, or neither), looks up the recipient and source bank accounts, calls MercuryService.sendPayment, and on success creates a BankTransaction__c and marks the upstream record paid.

Parameters:
    payments – Single-element list containing the PaymentRequest describing the payment to send

Returns:
    String[]: single-element array with a human-readable status (success message or error)
